title: Website Redesign in Kenya: 8 Signs It Is Time and What to Budget
title_sw: Kufanya Upya Tovuti Kenya: Ishara 8 na Bajeti Yake
excerpt: Eight signs your Kenyan business site needs a redesign, what to keep, and how to choose between Starter, Business and Commerce.
excerpt_sw: Ishara nane kwamba tovuti ya biashara yako Kenya inahitaji kufanywa upya, cha kuhifadhi, na jinsi ya kuchagua kati ya Starter, Business na Commerce.
content:
## A redesign is a business decision

Most redesigns do not start with design. They start with a business problem. Customers call asking for information that is already on the site. The site looks dated next to your current work. Nobody can find your location. Your team is embarrassed to send the link.

Before changing anything, write down what the new site must fix. A redesign without a problem statement becomes a prettier version of the same confusion.

## Eight signs it is time

- Customers ask questions the site should already answer.
- Your services or prices have changed but the pages have not.
- The site is hard to use on a phone.
- You cannot find it easily when you search your own business name.
- Photos, logos, or language no longer match the business you run today.
- Enquiries arrive through social media because the website feels unreliable.
- Pages take too long to load, especially on mobile data.
- You have useful content but no clear place to publish it.

You do not need all eight. Two or three are enough to justify a serious review.

## What to keep

Do not throw away everything because it looks old. Keep the page URLs that already have value, keep content that still ranks, and keep any process that customers already understand.

The safest redesign improves structure and clarity before it changes visual style. If a URL must change, use a permanent redirect. That protects the search value you have already built.

Write a simple list before the work starts: pages to keep, pages to merge, pages to remove, and new pages to add. That list becomes the map of the project.

## Budget in Kenya

A redesign does not always mean the most expensive package. If the job is to make an existing small site clearer and faster, Starter from KSh 25,000 may be enough. If the job includes several services, a blog, and a stronger quote path, look at Business from KSh 55,000. If the site must sell online, look at Commerce from KSh 120,000.

The right budget follows the problem. Do not buy Custom because it sounds serious. Buy Custom when you are building a system, not a set of pages.

## Content is the real work

Most redesign delays come from content, not code. Prepare your service descriptions, current prices, location details, photos, and answers to common questions before the build begins. Short, clear text beats long paragraphs that say nothing.

If you have both English and Kiswahili customers, plan both from the start. A bilingual site is not a translation added at the end.

## Next step

Use the Start a project button, or send a WhatsApp message to 0705 023 432 with your two strongest signs from the list above. You will get a clear recommendation on scope and package.

## Kufanya upya ni uamuzi wa biashara

Kufanya upya tovuti mara nyingi haitoki kwenye muundo. Hutoka kwenye tatizo la biashara. Wateja hupiga simu wakiuliza taarifa iliyopo tayari kwenye tovuti. Tovuti inaonekana ya zamani ikilinganishwa na kazi yako ya sasa. Watu hawaoni eneo lako. Timu yako inaona aibu kutuma kiungo.

Kabla ya kubadilisha chochote, andika tovuti mpya inapaswa kutatua nini. Kufanya upya bila tatizo huishia kuwa toleo zuri la machafuko yale yale.

## Ishara nane kwamba wakati umefika

- Wateja wanauliza maswali ambayo tovuti inapaswa kuwa tayari imejibu.
- Huduma au bei zako zimebadilika lakini kurasa hazijabadilika.
- Tovuti ni ngumu kutumia kwenye simu.
- Huipati kwa urahisi unapotafuta jina la biashara yako.
- Picha, nembo, au lugha hazilingani tena na biashara unayoendesha leo.
- Maswali yanafika kwenye mitandao ya kijamii kwa sababu tovuti inaonekana isiyoaminika.
- Kurasa huchukua muda mrefu kupakia, hasa kwenye data ya simu.
- Una maudhui muhimu lakini hakuna mahali wazi pa kuyachapisha.

Huhitaji zote nane. Mbili au tatu zinatosha kuhalalisha mapitio makini.

## Cha kuhifadhi

Usitupe kila kitu kwa sababu kinaonekana cha zamani. Hifadhi URLs zilizokuwa na thamani, hifadhi maudhui bado yanayopatikana kwenye utafutaji, na hifadhi mchakato ambao wateja tayari wanauelewa.

Kufanya upya salama huboresha muundo na uwazi kabla ya kubadilisha muonekano. Ikiwa URL lazima ibadilike, tumia redirect ya kudumu. Hiyo inalinda thamani ya utafutaji uliyojenga.

Andika orodha rahisi kabla kazi kuanza: kurasa za kuhifadhi, za kuunganisha, za kuondoa, na mpya za kuongeza. Orodha hiyo ndiyo ramani ya mradi.

## Bajeti nchini Kenya

Kufanya upya sio lazima kumaanisha kifurushi cha gharama kubwa. Ikiwa kazi ni kufanya tovuti ndogo iliyopo iwe wazi na haraka, Starter kuanzia KSh 25,000 inaweza kutosha. Ikiwa kazi inajumuisha huduma nyingi, blog, na njia bora ya ombi la bei, angalia Business kuanzia KSh 55,000. Ikiwa tovuti lazima iuze mtandaoni, angalia Commerce kuanzia KSh 120,000.

Bajeti sahihi hufuata tatizo. Usinunue Custom kwa sababu inasikika muhimu. Nunua Custom unapojenga mfumo, si seti ya kurasa.

## Maudhui ndiyo kazi halisi

Kuchelewa kwingi kwenye kufanya upya hutoka kwenye maudhui, si kodi. Tayarisha maelezo ya huduma, bei za sasa, maelezo ya eneo, picha, na majibu ya maswali ya kawaida kabla kazi kuanza. Maandishi mafupi na wazi hushinda aya ndefu zisizosema chochote.

Ikiwa una wateja wa Kiingereza na Kiswahili, panga lugha zote mbili tangu mwanzo. Tovuti ya lugha mbili sio tafsiri inayoongezwa mwishoni.

## Hatua inayofuata

Tumia kitufe cha Start a project, au tuma WhatsApp kwa 0705 023 432 ukiwa na ishara mbili zenye nguvu kutoka orodha hapo juu. Utapata ushauri wazi kuhusu upeo na kifurushi.
